title: Reflextions LLC
summary: Built a portfolio of more than 20 browser games, reaching 10 million+ plays across titles. Led development, product, and licensing across original and client IP, working with distributed freelance teams.
body:
### 10 million+ plays across games

Built and published a portfolio of more than 20 browser games, managing development, product direction, and licensing across original and client IP while collaborating with distributed freelance teams.

### Featured games

- [Red Tie Runner](https://nlbdotdev.itch.io/red-tie-runner) — a reflex-based platformer with 30 levels of obstacles, ziplines, and wingsuits.
- [Don't Fall!](https://nlbdotdev.itch.io/dont-fall) — competitive two-player ragdoll battles, plus a single-player survival challenge.
- [ProtoShift](https://nlbdotdev.itch.io/protoshift) — a fast-paced, mouse-controlled arcade game inspired by Super Hexagon.
